vb_textbox.text: There are two groups of gnomes that will appear, at a given time one group of gnomes will provide a higher yield of mushrooms than the other group. This may change throughout the round, do not be afraid to switch groups if you notice that they're no longer yielding a high amount (about 5+ mushrooms on average). The two groups are (orange, blue, pink, red) and (yellow, brown, purple, green. The gnomes will always show up in the same pairs orange+yellow, blue+brown, red+purple, pink+green. My best advice is to pick a group, observe how many mushrooms you get after several selections and if you get a consistently high yield of mushrooms, remain with that group. If you get a low amount of mushrooms or the yield suddenly becomes much lower, switch to the other group. Good luck!
